description: Unified 5-class taxonomy for human activity and posture monitoring on escalators, curated from sanitized SPHAR video streams.

NORMAL_RIDING_STANDING.description: Passenger standing upright or with minor natural postural adjustment without locomotion on escalator step.
NORMAL_RIDING_STANDING.rules: Upright spine, feet stationary, center of mass stable.
NORMAL_RIDING_STANDING.source_filters: SPHAR neutral clips filtered strictly for standing_upright; excludes gesture/vehicle interaction.

WALKING.description: Standard bipedal walking gait in forward direction.
WALKING.rules: Alternating foot contact, upright torso, standard cadence (1.0 - 1.8 m/s). Includes walking with luggage.
WALKING.source_filters: SPHAR walking (standard walking, carrying object, wandering walk).

RUNNING_RUSHING.description: Rapid locomotion, hurrying, or sprinting across steps.
RUNNING_RUSHING.rules: Forward torso lean, extended stride length, presence of flight phase, high cadence.
RUNNING_RUSHING.source_filters: SPHAR running (running, jogging; excluding acrobatic jumping).

SITTING_SQUATTING.description: Passenger seated on escalator step or in deep squat with knees flexed.
SITTING_SQUATTING.rules: Center of mass significantly lowered (<65% standing height), knees flexed >90°, buttocks near or on surface.
SITTING_SQUATTING.source_filters: SPHAR sitting (clean ground/bench/chair sitting; excludes vehicle ingress) + remapped CASIA crouch.

FALLEN_PERSON.description: Passenger recumbent, supine, or collapsed on steps following slip, trip, or medical event.
FALLEN_PERSON.rules: Sudden loss of vertical equilibrium, body axis horizontal/recumbent on floor/steps.
FALLEN_PERSON.source_filters: SPHAR falling (fainting collapse, slipping, lying on floor).

spatial_behaviours_outside_classifier.WRONG_DIRECTION_WALKING: Evaluated via Person Tracker trajectory vector (v_person dot v_escalator < 0), NOT appearance classifier.
spatial_behaviours_outside_classifier.BOUNDARY_CROSSING: Evaluated via Person Bounding Box IoU/intersection with handrail polygon ROI.
spatial_behaviours_outside_classifier.OVERCROWDING: Evaluated via active person count in defined escalator entrance/comb-plate zones.
